description: Find covered European cities by name (in any of the six languages), country or region. Returns the city id needed by the other tools, sight count, summary and web guide URL. Omit query to list all cities.

language.description: Language of names and descriptions: en, es, fr, de, tr or zh.

query.description: City, country or region text, e.g. "Seville" or "Portugal".

name: search_cities
title: Search cities
